name: 3/8" x 100'L Synthetic Winch Rope DYNEEMA Fiber
description: Synthetic Winch Rope is safer than wire rope and stronger than wire rope.It is extremely lightweight and easy to use. Made out of very strong and durable DYNEEMA Fiber this fiber does not kink or rust and will make your winch work more efficiently. It has a 3.15 Ton Eye Hoist Hook and a stainless steel standard thimble. Features a 1 meter Protective Sleeve in the front to give extra protection on the wire.WARNING: Do not exceed maximum allowed breaking strength.
